biotools.summary: HI-FEVER is a Nextflow pipeline for the high-throughput discovery and annotation of endogenous viral elements (EVEs) in host genomes, addressing challenges in paleovirology through a customizable and computationally efficient workflow. It is designed for ease of use and provides comprehensive analyses of discovered EVEs.
